context: Hi!
Hello how are you doing?
I'm good! How are you?

I recommend you to watch The Art of Racing in the Rain
Cool can you tell me a little bit about ti?

Denny Swift is a Formula One race car driver who understands that the techniques needed on the racetrack can also be used to successfully navigate everyday life. Besides his career, Denny has three loves of his life -- his beautiful wife, their young daughter and his best friend, which is a dog that wants to be reincarnated into a human.
That sounds amazing. I will absolutely check that out. I've never heard of it before but it sounds exactly like something I would enjoy.Thank you very much for the recommendation.
You're very welcome! I'm happy to help

Romantic and Drama

The notebook and Me before you
The notebook is such a great movie.
